transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, I'm here because I've been having some trouble with my eating. What really worries me is that once I start picking at food late at night, I'll tell myself, "That's enough, Santiago." But... my hand just keeps going back. It's honestly like I don't get to make the decision anymore once I start.
When this happens, do you eat an unusually large amount of food for the situation?

Yeah, I would say so. Like, on some nights after work, I can go through several tamales, a big bowl of pozole, some tortillas... and really whatever rice or beans are left over. And I just eat it all while standing there in the kitchen, almost like I'm just cleaning up the leftovers or something.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I don't do that. I just... well, I just feel really stuffed and uncomfortable afterwards. But I've never tried to make myself throw up or anything like that.
After these eating episodes, do you do anything to try to make up for the calories, like taking laxatives, fasting, or exercising hard?

No, I don't do any of that. I don't take pills or try to starve myself the next day. I definitely don't exercise like that either. I just kind of deal with feeling full and bad about it, and then I go to bed.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress?

I don't know if I'd call it a lot of distress. I mean, I definitely feel guilty about it, like I mentioned. It bothers me, and I get pretty annoyed with myself for eating so much when I wasn't even really hungry. But I don't know if it's... distress, exactly. It's mostly just frustrating, and then I just have to get up and go to work the next morning anyway.
How often do these eating episodes happen?

Well, for the past several months, it's been happening most weeks... at least once a week, anyway. It usually happens on a night when there are plenty of leftovers in the fridge and everyone else has already gone to bed.
During these episodes, do you eat much more quickly than you usually do?

Yeah, I do. I eat it pretty fast. Um... it's not like when I'm sitting down with my family for a normal dinner. It's more like I'm just trying to get it done before anyone wakes up. I eat so quick that I'm barely even tasting the food, honestly.
During these episodes, are you usually not physically hungry when you start eating?

Yeah, that's right. A lot of times I'm not even hungry. I mean, I usually already had a regular dinner with everybody earlier in the evening, so I'm full. But then later on... I don't know, I still just end up opening the fridge and starting all over again.
